<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def csize(fr):
    s=fr.segmentation; tot=0

        r1=max(p[0] for p in n['boundary']);c1=max(p[1] for p in n['boundary'])
        print('  ',n['color'],n['pixels'],f'r{r0}-{r1} c{c0}-{c1}')
